display_name: Celestial Heritage, Book I cover art

_provenance.source: the original cover (lone figure on a ridge, the ship half-buried in red dust, a glyph in the dusk sky, title stacked in the upper half), rebuilt on the approved canon: the photographic Valkyrie-1, the south trench (CH01) and Galen in the approved surface suit
_provenance.text_and_glyph: the title, author name and the three-arc glyph are NOT generated. They are set over the art afterwards (scripts/cover), so the sky must stay empty
_provenance.aspect: generate at 2:3 (1024x1536); the 9:16 end card is cropped from the same art
_provenance.parent: not inherited from south-trench on purpose: its dig-site machinery, shelter and shuttle don't belong on the cover
